newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Salomon reaffirms buy on Mosenergo.
newsitem.headline: Salomon reaffirms buy on Mosenergo.

text.p: Russian power utility Mosenergo 0#MSNG.RUO is considerably undervalued, investment bank Salomon Bros said on Thursday, reaffirming a buy recommendation on the Moscow regional power utility.

OAO Energetiki i Elektrifikatsii Mosenergo results for 1995 and 1994, restated to U.S. GAAP by auditing firm Arthur Andersen and released last week, demonstrate substantial progress in 1995, it said in a research note on Mosenergo.
Sales in dollar terms rose 52 percent and net income shot up 201 percent, while cash flow rose 44 percent, it said.

An independent evaluation of Mosenergo's assets by American Appraisal Ltd placed a value of $3.7 per share of gross fixed assets and $1.9 per share of net fixed assets -- an 80 percent premium to current share price, it said.
Earnings per share are likely to rise 39 percent for 1996 but slow in 1997 and 1998 to provide 20 percent compounded annual growth rates (CAGR) in earnings for 1996-98, it said.
Lower earnings growth in 1997-98 will reflect decelerating increases in average tariffs as residential tariffs rise and industrial tariffs decline.
Cash flow will be marginal but positive in 1996 because of a continuing non-payments problem, but an expected improvement in receivables by the end of 1997 will free up much cash.

Mosenergo is trading at a prospective 1996 price/earnings multiple of 4.3 times, firm value/earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) of 1.9 times and firm value/sales of 0.6 times, it said.

"Expected 20 percent CAGR in earnings and 17 percent CAGR in cash flow in 1996-98 make these multiples look low relative to other European and Asian utilities and in our view indicate that Mosenergo is considerably undervalued," it said.
Salomon managed a private placement of American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) for Mosenergo last year.
At 1245 GMT Mosenergo was $0.977 on the Russian Trading System (RTS), up from $0.975 at Wednesday's close.
